editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Mobile Developer Specialist (O11 and ODC) certification exam with official guidance, duration rules, and domain focus areas.
editorial.overview: The Mobile Developer Specialist (O11 and ODC) certification exam is officially provided by OutSystems with a duration of 60 minutes and a standard registration fee of $100 US. It evaluates your core capabilities in mobile design considerations, native app generation for Android and iOS native app packages, and modeling local storage data.
editorial.who_should_take: Mobile developers working with OutSystems 11 and ODC who build native mobile apps, design local storage data models, and configure app packages for Android and iOS platforms.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official OutSystems documentation covering offline data synchronization, local storage models, and mobile app packages completely before test day. Practice building mobile applications in both O11 and ODC environments, focusing on native plugin usage and mobile performance strategies to ensure full familiarity with all objectives.
